text: Sleep disturbances are prevalent among patients with methadone maintenance treatment (MMT) for opioid use disorder (OUD), yet the neurobiological implications remain poorly understood. So we investigated cortical thickness between the MMT and the MMT with sleep disturbances (MMTS) patients to determine the interplay between MMT, sleep disturbances, and cortical remodeling.
source_label: The effects of sleep disturbances on patients receiving methadone treatment for opioid use disorder: cortical thickness evidence
